title: Queen Mary Spruce Goose Brochure Lot Long Beach 1974 1984 Tour Map Vintage
condition_description: Both used with normal fold lines. Spruce Goose has "May 5, 1984" handwritten on the cover and a small yellow mark at the lower left edge; Queen Mary Tour has "Sept. 7, 1974" handwritten on the cover.
description:
Lot of 2 vintage Long Beach, California brochures - the Queen Mary and the Spruce Goose:

1) Vintage Spruce Goose "Bigger Than Life" visitor brochure from the Queen Mary and Spruce Goose attractions in Long Beach, California (A Wrather Property).

- Fold-out map of the Spruce Goose Dome with all 15 stops: the Hughes Flying Boat construction and flight exhibits, Howard Hughes the young aviator, world flight, life and film career, the cockpit viewing platform, cargo bay, Pratt & Whitney engine and more
- "A Word of Explanation" on how the Hercules H-4 got its nickname, plus a wingspan comparison chart (Spruce Goose vs. Boeing 747, DC-10, Space Shuttle Columbia)
- Queen Mary panel: harbor cruise and Hotel Queen Mary
- "Eat, Drink and Be Merry!" dining guide: Promenade Cafe, Sir Winston's, Verandah Grill, Art Deco Lounge, J.W.'s Tavern, The Hangar snack bar, Londontowne and Piccadilly Circus

Condition: used. The cover has a handwritten date, "May 5, 1984". Normal fold lines and light wear, with a small yellow mark at the lower left edge of the cover (see photos).

2) "Queen Mary Tour - 81,000 Tons of Fun in Long Beach, California" tri-fold brochure, dated by hand Sept. 7, 1974.

- Cutaway tour map of the ship by Al Bates: Queen Mary Museum (engine room, shaft alley, propeller), the Living Sea exhibit conceived by Jacques Cousteau, and the Upper Decks Tour (bridge, staterooms, Piccadilly Circus shops)
- Queen Mary Facts & Figures, Queen Mary Hyatt Hotel, restaurants and Mary's Gate Village
- 1974 admission prices: adults $3.75, children $1.75, parking $1.00

Condition: normal fold lines, light wear, handwritten date on the cover (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
